name: AFFiNE
short_description: Privacy-focused collaborative notes and whiteboard platform.
description: AFFiNE is an open-source, privacy-first alternative to Notion and Miro. It combines document editing, whiteboard drawing, and database-style pages in one unified workspace. Collaborate in real-time, organize with tags, and work offline with local-first sync.
usecases: Create rich documents and wikis with embedded whiteboards.
Collaborate in real-time on notes and visual mind maps.
Organize projects with edgeless canvas and structured pages.
